cohort: The study analyzed data from 1630 pregnant women with COVID-19 from the PregCovid registry.
finding: Higher spontaneous preterm births were reported during the second wave of the COVID-19 pandemic compared to the first wave and the pre-pandemic period.
cross-section timing: Data was analyzed between April 4, 2020, and July 4, 2021, comparing rates during the first wave (10 months), second wave (6 months), and a 1-year prepandemic period.
